about: Every baseline failure on c3 (17 of 25 questions: 16 false refusals, 1 wrong answer), with the earliest stage responsible. Built from baseline/*/records, the offline probes (iterations/iteration_001) and the offline replay. Labels are ASSISTANT judgments, not independent review. Root-cause groups are listed first; each failure record points to one.

F-EXT-MARKS.statement: c3 table rows carry no check-mark/cross cells, so a question that selects a row by its marks cannot be answered from c3 evidence; the model guesses a row (t05: wrong answer accepted, because the cited row really holds the guessed value).
F-EXT-MARKS.evidence: gold_units_in_context true but gold_units_complete_in_context false for t01, t05, t13, t10, t29; Phase 11F extraction audit; Phase 12 c6 answered t01/t05/t13 correctly with complete rows.
F-EXT-MARKS.proposed_change: c6 corpus (extraction e4) — needs the owner's separate activation approval; OUTSIDE this loop's authority (brief §16).
F-EXT-MARKS.status: open: activation proposal, not a loop iteration

F-RET-MISSING.statement: a required passage or row is ranked below the context cutoff or not retrieved.
F-RET-MISSING.evidence: q11 base row AIAYN:T3:r01 fused rank 5, reranked 9 (Phase 11F); q06, q10, q14 gold units not in context (Phase 11F: not retrieved offline either); q09 one of four units missing.
F-RET-MISSING.proposed_change: not yet: a retrieval change needs its own root cause per question (q11 reranker demotion vs q06/q10/q14 lexical mismatch)

F-VER-SUBJ.statement: the NLI model returns NEUTRAL (~0 entailment, ~0 contradiction) when a claim names the paper's model or adds a qualifier the passage lacks ('The original Transformer was trained on eight NVIDIA P100 GPUs' vs 'We trained our models on one machine with 8 NVIDIA P100 GPUs': 0.01; 'The models were trained on ...': 0.99). Number words vs digits are not the cause (0.99 both).
F-VER-SUBJ.evidence: scratch probes p2/p3 (iteration_001); q15, q02, q04 drafts.
F-VER-SUBJ.proposed_change: iteration_001: premise prefixed with the paper's verbatim self-identification sentence (verifier v4.3c)
F-VER-SUBJ.status: iteration_001 REJECTED offline (live replay false rejections 9 -> 10; it rescued no live failure because drafts add 'original'/'base' qualifiers)

F-UNICODE.statement: gpt-oss typographic Unicode (U+2011 non-breaking hyphen, U+202F narrow no-break space) breaks term matching and NLI.
F-UNICODE.evidence: present in most drafts (149 U+202F, 73 U+2011 in 33 drafts) and in 'term not in the cited passage' flags
F-UNICODE.status: REFUTED offline: normalising it flips 0 of 33 draft verdicts (flags are diagnostic only)

F-GEN-REDRAFT.statement: the redraft rarely fixes a rejected sentence: the redraft instruction says only 'Remove or fix those sentences', and gpt-oss often resends the rejected sentence unchanged or adds new unsupported content.
F-GEN-REDRAFT.evidence: baseline redraft success 2/17; identical rejected sentence resent in q15, q02, t29 (Phase 12) and q04 (0.40 -> 0.69, same content); verifier accepts close restatements of the passage (probes).
F-GEN-REDRAFT.proposed_change: iteration_002: prompt candidate p5r (redraft instruction only: delete or restate in the cited passage's own words, no added qualifiers/names, cite the passage holding each number, never repeat a listed sentence)

F-GEN-UNSUPPORTED.statement: drafts add content the cited passage does not state (inaccurate paraphrase, conclusion without citation, comparison citing one row, false absence claim, numbers cited to a passage without them); the verifier correctly rejects these.
F-GEN-UNSUPPORTED.evidence: q07 ('encoder contains only self-attention sub-layers'), q09 (uncited conclusion), q13 (comparison cites only HNET:T2:r11), q12 (absence claim contradicted by MOSHI:5.5:c091), q08 redraft (numbers cited to text without them)
F-GEN-UNSUPPORTED.proposed_change: covered by iteration_002 for the redraft; first-draft wording would be a separate prompt change
